title: Span compression adapter for high-cardinality request workloads
creator: Avery Chen
description: Build a run-time middleware (SDK + agent) that compresses repetitive span output for high-cardinality request patterns common in LLM inference (long streaming chat, batched token expansion). Goals: reduce exporter bandwidth and storage costs without losing critical span semantics for debugging and SLOs. Approach: coalesce near-duplicate child spans (same op name + attributes) within a short time window, encode repetition as a count + delta histogram, and optionally elide low-value tags while preserving sampling hints and provenance. Must be backward-compatible with existing OpenTelemetry consumers: provide on-export expansion and a compact binary carrier for edge SDKs. Deliverables: Go/Node SDK adapters, a sidecar transformer for our observability pipeline, unit/integration tests, perf benchmarks showing >=3x reduction in exported span volume on synthetic workloads, and a staged rollout with integrity checks and metric alarms.
comments: 2025-03-12 - Kickoff: scoped MVP to span-level compression, not event-level dedupe. Design doc link added to attachments. Action: implement Go SDK adapter first (most traffic) and sidecar fallback.

2025-03-13 - Design review: security/forensics asked to keep full-span payload for sampled traces; we agreed to preserve full payload for sampled traces and compress only unsampled or low-sampled spans. Marcus to prototype compression encoding (proto + zlib) and benchmark CPU cost.

2025-03-14 - Prototype results: prototype reduced span count by 4.1x for streaming chat generator during local test but CPU overhead on small GPUs increased ~6%. Trade-off: move heavy compression to sidecar when CPU-constrained and use lightweight delta encoding in SDKs.

2025-03-14 - Next: add integration tests with console trace-visualizer to ensure UI can expand compressed traces on-demand. Prepare canary rollout plan targeting low-traffic customers and internal staging.
2025-03-14 - PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3862 (WIP) - includes Go adapter and sidecar transformer skeleton. Requesting review from @sara.kim and @elias.borg.
notes: Rollout will include an opt-out header for customers and a feature flag per deployment. Monitoring: compression_ratio, expanded_span_errors, trace_integrity_failures, exporter_rate, tail_latency. If any integrity failures > 0.1% on canary, automatic rollback policy triggers.
